name: Weather Watch Subscriber
description: One (grid cell, user) subscription for severe-weather push notifications. TENANT-side doctype: rows are self-registered by the tenant get_weather_warnings proxy (frappe.session.user of the requester) and consumed by the hourly tenant push-sync job. watch_location stores the shared 0.25 degree grid key string (the Weather Watch Location doctype lives control-side, where grid keys are the location names), so many users may subscribe to one cell. Subscribers whose last_requested_at is older than 30 days are not pushed to. All datetimes are UTC.
